sloka: अन्योन्यं ते महाभागा जघ्नुः प्रहरणैर्भृशम् ।यमस्य च महाबाहो रावणस्य च मन्त्रिणः ।। ७.२१.३२ ॥
transliteration: anyonyaṁ te mahābhāgā jaghnuḥ praharaṇairbhṛśam ।yamasya ca mahābāho rāvaṇasya ca mantriṇaḥ ।। 7.21.32 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, those great ministers of Yama and Ravana fiercely struck each other with their weapons.
